name: carotid_bifurcation_cfd
description: Voxel CFD screening: WSS/OSI behaviour under a carotid-like pulsatile waveform, anchored by the Poiseuille verification and a stenosed-tube reference run.

fluid.note: blood-analog; real-blood development time R^2/nu ~ 1 s is outside the test march budget

expected.name: paraboloid_profile
expected.assert: constant radial second derivative (within 10%), symmetric about axis, wall intercept at mask radius + ghost

expected.name: wall_shear_vs_tube_law
expected.value: tau_sim / (4 mu Q / pi R^3) in [0.4, 1.6]

model.geometry: 24x12x12 voxels, 0.5 mm pitch, 40% Gaussian stenosis (carotid-wss-screening example)
model.blood: Carreau-Yasuda (mu0=0.056, mu_inf=0.0035, lambda=11.5 s, a=1.9, n=0.22)

metrics.name: throat_wss_over_field_mean
metrics.note: accelerated flow through the stenosis throat

notes: Stair-step walls over-estimate wall gradients; ratios are screening anchors, not clinical WSS values.
True bifurcation geometry (Y-split mask) lands with mask assembly tools; the stenosed tube exercises the same solver paths.
